### The night: 3 bugs found, 3 fixed

- **`842cda3` (backend)** — `MAP[userInput] ?? fallback` on a plain object literal 500'd on inherited `Object.prototype` names. Two reachable sites; the work-order one also left **orphan rows** because the INSERT ran before the throw. Ordinary unknown keys fell back fine, which is why every prior sweep passed.
- **`aff13c2` / `18837f7` (UI)** — 16 of 22 modal close buttons had no box (bare 18×18–20×23 non-square, three offsets, no hover); one slide-over close had its hover killed by an inline `background:'none'`.
- **s2 found zero frontend defects** across 13/13 routes and all 15 Settings tabs.

### Two things I want to flag rather than bury

**The headline numbers overstate coverage.** s1 and s4 both terminated on `max_turns`, so I wrote the report around that rather than reporting 133/272 as if it were a result:

- Only **133 of 272 API routes ran**. GET was 132/132 clean, but **every POST/DELETE/PATCH/PUT bulk sweep never executed** — last night did 258/272 with PATCH/PUT at 34/34. Nothing regressed; the sweeps simply didn't run.
- **s4 produced no verdict**, so tonight's fixes have no independent verification. I did confirm all three are present in the tree at the source level (`admin.js:130`, `workOrderService.js:156`, `.modal-close` at `index.css:1645` applied at 16 sites, `SubcontractorsView.jsx:261` now class-only) and the build is clean — but that's weaker than a real verify pass, and the report says so.

**Two stale-file traps I corrected rather than propagating.** The task pointed at `/tmp/api-test-results.txt` and `/tmp/ui-audit-results.txt`; those are from **Aug 19 and Aug 25**, and `/tmp/frontend-test-results.txt` doesn't exist. In Git Bash `/tmp` resolves to `C:/Users/brand/AppData/Local/Temp`, which is **not** `C:/tmp` — tonight's real artifacts are `C:/tmp/frontend-test-results.txt` and `C:/tmp/ui-audit-results.txt`. I used those, and documented the path split so the next run doesn't report Run 82 data as current.

Also corrected a counting detail: the audit's "22 close buttons" is a count of *measured* instances; source has **25** (16 `.modal-close` + 9 `.slide-over__close`, the extra 3 being nested modals in `LeadDetail.jsx`). All 25 carry a class, so the fix is complete either way.

### Needs your decision

1. **`qa_options_probe`** is still live in the production DB and **user-visible in Settings → Custom Fields**. Confirmed safe to delete (0 leads reference it). It escapes the nightly cleanup because that sweep matches `'QA-R9%'` and this label doesn't. One `DELETE` and your go-ahead.
2. **Form label drift** (~100 labels / 19 files) — left unconverted deliberately, third run running. A subset conversion adds a new inconsistency axis; the full pass is a refactor.

The systemic issue is the stage capping — eight consecutive nights, and it's now costing coverage rather than just throughput.
